name: Beta-eucaine
aliases: eucaine, betacain, betacaine, eucain B, eucaine B, β-eucaine
summary: Eucaine, also known as β-eucaine or Betacaine, is a drug that was previously used as a local anesthetic. It was designed as an analog of cocaine and was one of the first synthetic chemical compounds to find general use as an anesthetic. It is a white, crystalline solid. Prior to World War I, Britain imported eucaine from Germany.

uses.text: Eucaine, also known as β-eucaine or Betacaine, is a drug that was previously used as a local anesthetic. It was designed as an analog of cocaine and was one of the first synthetic chemical compounds to find general use as an anesthetic.

pharmacology.en: Like other local anaesthetics, it blocks the sodium channels that nerve cells use to fire, so the nerve cannot pass a pain signal along and the area goes numb.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他局部麻醉劑一樣，它阻斷神經細胞放電所用的鈉離子通道，使神經無法傳遞疼痛訊號，該區域便失去感覺。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他局部麻醉剂一样，它阻断神经细胞放电所用的钠离子信道，使神经无法传递疼痛信号，该区域便失去感觉。

sideEffects.en: It irritated tissue more than later anaesthetics, which is why it fell out of use. Local anaesthetics reaching the bloodstream can cause ringing in the ears, seizures and heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 它對組織的刺激性比後來的麻醉劑強，因此逐漸不再使用。局部麻醉劑進入血流可能造成耳鳴、癲癇發作與心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对组织的刺激性比后来的麻醉剂强，因此逐渐不再使用。局部麻醉剂进入血流可能造成耳鸣、癫痫发作与心律问题。

fact.en: Beta-eucaine, from the 1890s, was one of the first synthetic drugs to replace a natural product in everyday medicine. It was designed as a simplified cocaine, keeping the numbing part and dropping the rest.
fact.zh: β-eucaine 問世於 1890 年代，是最早在日常醫療中取代天然產物的合成藥物之一。它被設計為簡化版的古柯鹼，保留麻醉部分而捨棄其餘結構。
fact.zhHans: β-eucaine 问世于 1890 年代，是最早在日常医疗中取代天然产物的合成药物之一。它被设计为简化版的古柯碱，保留麻醉部分而舍弃其余结构。
